🚀VO2 GROUP: The Bright Side of Tech 🌈

___________________________________________________________________


Nos clients dans les secteurs de la banque et de la finance, nos clients choisissent désormais l'innovation et la technologie pour se transformer. Spécialiste en conseil organisationnel, en amélioration des performances commerciales et en optimisation de l'expérience client grâce à l'informatique et à l'IA, VO2 Finance propose une expertise digitale à la fois technologique, méthodologique et sectorielle – incluant le financement, les marchés de capitaux, les opérations front, middle et back office, les systèmes d'information bancaires et la réglementation.

 

CONTEXTE

Dans le cadre du renforcement des dispositifs de contrôle de notre client bancaire sur le périmètre Front Office / Risques, vous intégrerez l'équipe chargée d'assurer la conformité et la sécurité des opérations sur les marchés financiers.

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous prendrez la responsabilité du périmètre de la surveillance des événements externes à la banque (hors SI) susceptibles d'être qualifiés d'abus de marché (MAR) et devant faire l'objet de déclarations réglementaires. Vous jouerez un rôle référent pour la direction et l'ensemble des parties prenantes.

 

DESCRIPTIF DE LA MISSION

Au quotidien, vous piloterez le sujet en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Risques, Métiers, IT et la Direction autour des axes suivants :

  • Surveillance des événements externes : Identifier, analyser et cadrer l'ensemble des flux et données externes hors SI présentant des suspicions d'abus de marché (MAR).

  • Analyse de flux et réconciliation : Cartographier les schémas de flux de données complexes, concevoir et exécuter les schémas de réconciliation dans une approche stricte orientée Risque.

  • Déclarations réglementaires : Valider les dossiers et formaliser les notifications de suspicion destinées aux régulateurs, en garantissant le respect des contraintes de temporalité.

  • Exploration, Manipulation & Modélisation de données : Traiter et croiser d'importantes volumétries de données (Python, SQL, Excel) pour identifier les anomalies et optimiser les règles de détection.

  • Coordination & Posture : Interagir directement avec les équipes IT pour faire évoluer le dispositif et apporter un rôle de conseil/référent auprès de la direction.

 

Livrables à produire (liste non exhaustive) :

  • Schémas de réconciliation des données et cartographies de flux externes.

  • Fiches d'analyse d'incidents complexes et dossiers de déclaration de suspicion pour le régulateur.

  • Tableaux de bord de suivi des alertes, indicateurs de temporalité et cartographies de risques.

  • Documentation fonctionnelle, préconisations techniques pour l'IT et comptes-rendus d'analyses.


Profil recherché 🔎

  • Formation : Bac+5 (École d'ingénieurs ou Master spécialisé en Finance/Data).

  • Expérience : 8 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Analysis appliquée aux marchés financiers (environnement Front Office et/ou Risques).

  • Expertise métier : Maîtrise approfondie des activités de marché, des mécanismes de réconciliation et de la réglementation sur les abus de marché (MAR).

  • Compétences techniques : Maîtrise avancée de Python, SQL et Excel pour le traitement et la modélisation de données complexes.

  • Soft Skills : Excellente capacité d'analyse, posture affirmée pour rassurer le management, leadership et aisance relationnelle pour challenger les équipes IT et métiers.

  • Langues : Anglais courant (environnement international).


    • Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 🚀

  • Politique de télétravail (2 jours/semaine)
  • Bonus de cooptation de 2 000 à 3 000 €

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Senior Consultant - Business Analyst, Reporting & MIS (Private Banking)
Financial Analyst Transaction Services & FP&A (m/w/d)
description:
Für die Verbindung von Transaktionsarbeit und operativer Finanzplanung suchen wir ein analytisch starkes Financial Profil mit 3–6 Jahren Berufserfahrung in Transaction Services, Financial Due Diligence oder FP&A. Du bewertest Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst Umsatz- und Ergebnisannahmen und übersetzt Finanzdaten in belastbare Entscheidungsgrundlagen – mit besonderem Blick auf SaaS-Kennzahlen und die Zeit nach dem Closing.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und überprüfst Bewertungsmodelle und erstellst unlevered-IRR-Szenarien.
  • Du analysierst Umsatztreiber, Kunden- und Erlösentwicklungen und führst Revenue-Driver-Checks durch.
  • Du wertest Registerabschlüsse und weitere Finanzinformationen strukturiert aus und leitest relevante Erkenntnisse ab.
  • Du koordinierst finanzielle Due-Diligence-Arbeitspakete (FDD) mit internen und externen Beteiligten.
  • Du baust eine belastbare KPI-Baseline auf und unterstützt beim Übergang von der Transaktion in die Umsetzung.
  • Du entwickelst Beteiligungs- und Performance-Reporting nach dem Closing weiter.
  • Du analysierst SaaS-Geschäftsmodelle und beurteilst Kennzahlen wie ARR, NRR und Cash Conversion.
  • Du bereitest Ergebnisse klar und adressatengerecht für Entscheidungsträger auf.

Qualifikation

  • 3–6 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in Transaction Services, Financial Due Diligence, FP&A oder einer vergleichbaren analytischen Finanzfunktion.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Finanzmodellen, Unternehmensbewertungen und Szenarioanalysen.
  • Sicherheit in der Analyse von Abschlüssen sowie in der Plausibilisierung von Umsatz-, Kosten- und Cashflow-Entwicklungen.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse relevanter SaaS-Kennzahlen, insbesondere ARR, NRR und Cash Conversion.
  • Erfahrung in der Koordination von Due-Diligence-Prozessen und/oder im Reporting nach dem Closing.
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis.
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Analysen verständlich zusammenzufassen und souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder vergleichbaren Modellierungswerkzeugen.

Was dich in der Rolle erwartetDu arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Transaktionsanalyse, Finanzplanung und Wertentwicklung. Dabei verbindest du präzise Modellierung mit einem pragmatischen Blick auf die operativen Treiber eines Unternehmens – von der ersten Analyse bis zur KPI-Steuerung nach dem Closing.

Wenn du Erfahrung in Transaction Services oder FP&A mitbringst und SaaS-Kennzahlen sicher einordnen kannst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Bitte sende deinen Lebenslauf und – sofern verfügbar – ein kurzes Beispiel relevanter Modellierungs- oder Analyseerfahrung.

Benefits

Neben unserem hoch motivierten Team und einem erfolgreichen Produkt:

✓ Innovation mit Sicherheit: Bei uns trifft Start-up-Atmosphäre auf wirtschaftliche Stabilität.
✓ Work-Life-Balance: Wir fördern einen Arbeitsalltag frei von Überstunden, Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit.
✓ Diversität und Transparenz: Sei wie du bist. Ein offenes Arbeitsumfeld und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe erwarten dich.
✓ Fort- und Weiterbildung: Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an deinem Karriereweg bei uns.
✓ Weitere Benefits für dein Wohlbefinden: (virtuelle) Teamevents, Rabatte für Mitarbeitende, Sportangebote, Mentoring & Coaching, Gesundheits- sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge u. v. m.

title: Content Operations Associate
description:
Hi 👋 I'm Deyan, Director of Corporate Marketing at hyperexponential.

I lead Corporate Marketing: brand creative and design, PR and communications, flagship events, and owned media. We partner with teams across the business to produce a high volume of long-form and short-form content. A podcast episode or a report becomes clips, articles, exec posts, and social across everything the department touches.

I'm hiring a Content Operations Associate to help turn that into a repeatable operation. You'll build the pipelines that carry our content from raw material to published output, run them day to day, and make each cycle better than the last. You'll work across every part of the department rather than sitting inside one slice of it.

It's an operations role, not a strategy one. That's deliberate. You'll be close to the editorial thinking without owning it, and your job is the machinery underneath. If that's the kind of problem you want to solve, I'd love to hear from you.

About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry: which risks to take and how to price them. These decisions shape real-world outcomes. Whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has made billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We're already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do. From building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Impact isn't tied to title or tenure. It's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Marketing at hx builds authority and demand in a niche, technically complex space. This isn't volume-driven marketing. It's deliberate, high-quality work where every output is expected to earn its place.

This role sits in Corporate Marketing: brand, content, flagship events, PR and comms, design and multimedia, and owned media. We partner with teams across the business to produce a high volume of long-form and short-form content. The opportunity now is to turn that into a repeatable operation. The pipelines that take a podcast episode or a report and turn it into clips, articles, exec posts and social. You'll help build those pipelines, run them day to day, and make each cycle better than the last.

It's an operations role rather than a strategy one. You'll be close to the editorial thinking and pick up plenty of it, but your job is the machinery that carries it.

Check out our Marketing & GTM Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining.

What you'll be doing

Map how hx's content actually gets made. The tools, the sequence, the hand-offs, and where it breaks. Keep that picture current as the operation changes around it.

Run the production cycle across our content programmes (customer stories, the podcast, thought leadership and executive comms). Brief our agency partners, hold the quality bar on what comes back, and hit the publish dates. Take a growing share of that work in-house as you learn how it runs.

Draft copy for new web pages and projects. We draft with Claude against a codified brand voice, so you're never starting from blank. Work with input from internal SMEs and run the loop between programme owners, designers and agency partners. Brief in, feedback consolidated, builds QA'd, pages live on the date agreed.

Keep the hx thought leadership calendar operationally sound. Set the schedule, make the call on what runs when, chase the drafts, and cut existing long-form into the clips, posts and articles that feed our channels.

Keep the operations behind our named-voice programme running. The scheduling, the queue, the approvals, the chasing. So the experts and execs who carry our thought leadership post on cadence without having to manage the process themselves.

Build the templates, prompts and share packs the wider team publishes from. Good work shouldn't depend on you being available.

Learn how we stay visible in AI-generated answers as well as search results. Work out how that content gets published and distributed across the blog and website.

You'll start by running these cycles with support. Within a year we'd expect you to own them end to end and have a view on what we build next.

What we're looking for

  • You'll need to take on ownership and responsibility from the start, whatever your level. We care more about how you work than how long you've worked, and we don't expect you to have done all of this before.

  • You've made and published something (a newsletter, a channel, a society page, client work) and found yourself more interested in how it got made than in the making.

  • You're organised in a way other people can see. You track what's outstanding, you follow up, and you flag problems early rather than absorbing them.

  • You use AI properly in your own work. Reusable prompts and templates that make a recurring task faster, not a tool you tried once.

  • You pick things up by using them rather than waiting to be trained.

  • Familiarity with a CMS, a scheduling tool, or a project tracker.

  • Bonus points if you've got work out of someone you couldn't instruct (an agency, a freelancer, a collaborator) by writing a clear ask and going back when it wasn't right.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You expect full product maturity, clear roadmaps, and well-defined processes before taking action - hx moves fast and requires comfort operating in ambiguity where products, priorities, and messaging are still evolving.

  • You focus primarily on flashy launch work or brand campaigns rather than the detail-oriented, outcomes-driven work of deepening adoption, engagement, and user understanding.

  • You struggle to prioritise or make trade-offs without perfect information, waiting for others to decide rather than using judgment to move work forward with the context available.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process. Our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations. We're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Talent Screening

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Skills Assessment: a take-home exercise, followed by a review session

  4. Values Interview

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do. It's key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, apply or share it with your connections. Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, visit our careers page.

Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen und Lösungen bauen, die wirklich zählen? Bewirb dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die Energiewelt von morgen.

Zu den wichtigsten Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:
